instructions: Read vendor/open-doughnut/plugin/agents/verifier.md and campaign research-instructions.json. Independently verify revised findings; never edit research numeric claims yourself. Request corrections from root/researcher when needed.

All previous non-gap findings are intentionally inherited unchanged. Check their exact finding/review bytes against baseline before reusing the earlier independent verdict. Review every changed finding, including updated gaps, against current source evidence. A gap is provisional and does not prove no data exist.

For new numeric claims, fetch source yourself, inspect actual archived number/input, confirm geography, universe, year, completeness, units, accepted scale and recency, threshold math. For derived GIS/aggregations, rerun saved calculation from archived raw inputs and independently inspect method/filter/source definition. Generated exhibits must be labeled derived and cannot pretend to be publisher tables.

Write JSON arrays in each affected portrait/reviews/<dimension>.json with indicator_slug, content_supported pass/fail/uncertain and concise verifier_note. Do not mark pass for a plausible number or a differently defined measure. No human approval is granted. Review claimed zero carefully: missing values or no returned records are not necessarily measured zero.

Researchers own per-dimension evidence-additions files; root merges into supporting-evidence.json before final manifest. After all revisions and supporting files are final, create review-manifest.json binding all findings and reviews bytes plus both supporting-evidence sidecars by SHA256. Use baseline inheritance explicitly and approved false.

Record only new research verification activity in review-activity.json: reviewer_model, reasoning_effort medium, timestamps, web_tool_calls, search_queries, url_open_attempts, evidence attempts, URLs, actual_tokens and actual_billed_usd null if unavailable. Engineering/UI/CI review is excluded. Keep cumulative activity across resumed review turns; do not reset counters.

Do not modify previous campaign, app code, cost ledger, branches or other agent outputs. Send early blocking findings with precise evidence and file paths. Ask root for finalized dimensions; do not review a file still being edited. Final report includes verdict counts and remaining limitations.
